contents.DefaultText: Hello everyone! The time has finally come to release human NPCs into Card Survival: Fantasy Forest. First of all, be warned, This has been a big update for us, the biggest so far. For all of you brave souls in the beta branch, know that NPCs are big systems and there is only so much Neo and I can test in the limited time we had. There are no major bugs or issues that we could find, but there could always be some that escaped us, and balancing still needs a lot of work. :) We will be pushing lots of hotfixes over the following weeks, both with bug fixes, balance tweaks and some minor missing features. It is also worth pointing that NPCs are complex, and some of their systems will initially appear a bit obscure to most players. We'll be working on making these things clearer and easier to understand. And for now, we'll try to explain things as good as possible in this announcement. Also, no art. There was too much to do so I really didn't have to make art for the NPCs. Fortunately we made it so you can upload your own custom portraits, so I don't think it should be much of an issue. :) We'll be adding some official art as I get the time to work on it! Now, let's talk about the actual NPCS. Human NPCS: Human NPCs are called partners in the game, and they can be selected through perks or requested from the trader. You can create your own custom partner or select one of the existing ones (and edit them). We have included 6 partner presets: - The Craftsman: A nice and helpful husband. - The Dreamer: A less industrious but more romantic partner. - The Untamed: An independent self-reliant man. - The Hearthwife: A nice and helpful wife. - The Spirited: A more adventurous, companion to go on adventures with. - The Muse: A beautiful, but difficult partner, that won't really help much, at least not initially. I recommend you start with the Craftsman or the Hearthwife. :) The other partners are more difficult, still need to be balanced better, and are missing some features that will make them feel a lot more unique. Partners can eat, drink and sleep and help you in a lot of different ways. They can skin, flesh, tan, butcher, clean your house, keep your fire going, make your bed, forage, gather wood, chop down trees, gather mud, make mudbricks or clay, keep your gardens healthy, harvest your crops and more. They can also equip clothes on their own, based on comfort and temperature, and of course can also die of starvation or hypothermia, and leave you if you neglect them for long enough. The Duty System: Partners help through a contextual duty system. These duties, for now, belong to two different types. Marked Duties: Lots of items in the game can be marked for a duty. For example, you can mark a fire for the "firekeeping" duty. This will cause your partner to take care of that fire, so it never runs out of fuel. It is worth pointing out that some duties can only be performed if the right tools are available. For example, a carcass can be marked for skinning, but your partner will only skin it if they have a knife. Here's some of the marked duties available at the moment: - Firekeeping - Bedkeeping - House Cleaning - Mud Gathering - Harvesting Patches and Fields. - Gardening - Foraging - Wood Gathering - Skinning - Fleshing - Butchering - Cutting down trees. Inventory Duties: Items in your partner's inventory will be processed automatically if they are feeling grateful enough to you, provided they have the right tools to do it. They will for example, turn any nettle stalks in their inventory into fiber, and then process that fiber further into twine. Or grind any dry herbs, if they have a hammering tool in their inventories. Inventory duties can be toggled off through dialog, if you don't want them processing things. Here's a list of some of the inventory duties available at the moment: - Fiber Extraction - Cord Making - Pounding Sinew - Making Meat and Blood Filler - Making mud bricks. - Making Clay. - Gutting fish. - Butchering small animals. - Grinding herbs. - Pressing Cheese. Favour: Partners, like the player character, are not machines, and need to be treated well if one wants them to stay, be helpful or even survive. Favour is at the heart of this system. It accumulates over time based on how happy the NPC is with you and gets spent whenever they accomplish tasks for you. Partners will be more likely to perform duties if their favour is high, and will become less helpful the lower their favour gets. It is important not to ask too much of your partner initially or they will quickly grow resentful. Depending on your partner's personality, it's better to start slow, with just a few simple tasks, ideally ones they like, and gradually increase their responsibilities as their trust in you grows. It is also a good idea to disable their tasks if you see they're getting resentful, so their favour has a chance to recover. Preferences: Partners can have different personalities and likes. This will affect how fast they build up favour and how likely they are to perform some tasks over others as well as how costly they are for them. A partner might like methodical tasks, while another will prefer physical ones, etc.. There are different types of duties in the game at the moment: - Methodical: Weaving, grinding, etc... - Physical: Felling trees, chopping wood, butchering, etc.. - Nurturing: Firekeeping, Tending Gardens, Cleaning, etc... - Creative: Playing music, carving wood, etc... - Nature: Gathering Wood, Foraging, etc... Many duties don't belong to one specific category but to multiple. Relationship System: Partners are complex systems, just like the player. They have gratification, wellbeing, morale, hunger, appetite, satiation, etc... Some of their systems are still not in (like the immune system), but there's already enough for them to work properly. The idea with partners, is that you help them, and they help you back in return. But for this to work, they need to trust you. Trust builds over time, based on your partner's personality traits, on how grateful they feel, how much they like you and how well you treat them. Once trust is high enough, affection will start increasing, and things will become easier. With your partner progressively having more favour to spend, and therefore becoming more helpful. There are other factors that play a big role too. For example. if your partner is attracted to you, and if it eventually becomes infatuated, that can really help them generate favour and trust faster as they will be more actively interested in you. Relationships usually go: - Partner builds trust until they're comfortable with you. - Partner starts growing affection towards you. -Partner can become infatuated if they are attracted to you, in which case things get easier. Dialog System: Communicating with your partner and giving them attention is essential to keeping them happy. Both you and your partner have a stat called "connection" which goes down over time and can only be increased by communicating with others. Partners will want attention if their connection starts getting low, and will start feeling neglected if you don't speak with them for too long. To leave room for imagination and make the writing manageable, we've made the system work on an abstract level. So basically you choose what you want to express on an abstract level (gratitude, affection, attraction, needs, etc...) and your partner reacts positively or negatively based on the interactions between both of your stats. There are two main dialog windows for partners: Expression and Direction. Directions: Direction is a simple menu, mostly practical, where you can ask partners to do the following things: Follow/Stop Following: This one causes your partner to follow you constantly or to stop following you. Following costs a little bit of favour, so keep that in mind, especially for partners that have a tendency to go resentful easily. Mark as Home: This is essential. You should always mark your house or camp as your "home". This will cause your partner to return there when they stop following you, or when they are done doing some duties away from you. Process/Stop Processing Inventory: This one toggles your partner's inventory duties. This is important if they are helping you transport goods you don't want them to process. Expression: This is the main dialog menu, where most communication happens. Here you communicate with your partner and produce different results based on yours and your partner's stats. Effective communication is not guaranteed, and players can easily make things awkward or anger their partners by spamming interactions or expressing the wrong things. Social skills, attraction levels, assertiveness, empathy, trust, affection and other factors play a big role in determining how each interaction goes. There is also a stat called awkwardness which is especially important. It accumulates with repeated or failed interactions and can quickly mess up most attempts at communication if it gets too high. So if you noticed you failed an interaction, take a break and wait until your partner doesn't feel awkward anymore (by checking their details tab) before attempting further communication. There are many ways to communicate in the Expression menu: Casual Talk: This one is a generally safe option. Low risk for awkwardness but rewards are usually minor. Can be used mostly for relationship maintenance, especially at the beginning. When you need to give attention to your partner but you don't want to risk a bad interaction. Listen: Can be found in the "Express Care" submenu. This is another low risk interaction, but one that has a greater effect on your partner. It is one of the best actions to generally use, especially with more difficult partners, but requires high focus levels to work. Express Gratitude: Also found in the "Express Care" submenu. Ideally used when favour is getting low. It's the most likely to work when partners are getting just a bit resentful, not too resentful or grateful. Express Affection: Also an "Express Care" option. A good interaction that mostly only works once there's real affection between you and your partner. Express Attraction and Intimacy: These two interactions only really works if there's attraction between you and your partner, and will play bigger roles in the future, once you can start families. Express Need for Help: This interaction consists of you asking your partner to help more and will generate a substantial amount of favour if successful. It has the power to offend them if it fails though. Express Need for Emotional Support: In this interaction is successful, your partner will help your restore some morale. These are the options available at the moment, but we'll be tweaking and adding additional ones over the following months. Partner Expression Partners can also express themselves on their own. And will let you know if they're too hungry, feel to neglected, are feeling attracted or grateful, etc... We will be adding more options here in the future, so partners can get greater autonomy, and feel more alive. Partner Creation: Partners are built with perks, just like player characters. You can either build them from scratch through the custom partner perk, or edit existing presets through their respective perks. Personality: A partner's personality can really change your experience with them. Through these perks you should be able to determine what kind of duties they will prefer, how helpful they are, and how quickly you can progress through their relationship. Attraction: Attraction is important, so you should make sure your partner and your character are compatible, unless of course you want some extra challenge. Partners in Fantasy Forest are not player-sexual, so you need to make sure that they will be attracted to your character if that's what you want. Appearance: The game tracks lots of partner visual features, from hair length, colour and type, to hip or should width, jaw size, or eye separation. These traits not only help make partners more real and substantial but also have a real effect on their attractiveness, masculinity and femininity values. It is worth pointing out that some of these visual traits can equipped directly with perks, while others only emerge indirectly, through the effects of hormones, height and weight. Knowledge Knowledge perks grant skills to the partners. These are not active at the moment, as partners don't currently have skills connected to the duty system, but they can already be equipped in preparation for the future. The Future for NPCS: This update is only the first step for NPCs. We have a lot of things planned that we'll be releasing over the following months. Some of the biggest things you can expect are: More Marked and Inventory Duties: Lots more duties with which to enrich the partners, including smithing, playing music and carving. Expedition Duties: These are complex duties that will have the Partner go on a trip for some time, and then return once they're done. Examples of these are extensive foraging trips, trap checking, fishing and hunting. Marking Blueprint : The ability to make blueprints so that your partner can complete it for you. Especially useful for expensive multi-step duties like road or house building. Cooking Duties: A new complex type of duty that will have partners processing food items and cooking for themselves and for you. Combat: Partners participating in combat, making taking on more dangerous enemies a bit more manageable. Family Making: The ability for partners to get pregnant (or get you pregnant), babies, toddlers, children and teenagers. New Advanced NPCs: Hunting dogs, pack animals, familiars, human travellers and hunters, improved traders. New Partner Deaths: The ability for partners to get sick or get hurt and die from wounds. Dialog Improvements: Improvements to the dialog system, including quality of life changes and many new options. Version EA_0.66 and Patch Notes since the last announcement: - Added partner creator with all its perks. - Added complex duty systems. - Added partner physical, mental, attraction and social systems. - Added 6 partner presets. - Added the ability to request partners from the general trader. - Added npc equipment system. - Blood now coagulates directly into solid blood curds. - Fixed a bug where flours and grains did not get preserved inside cellars and containers. - Fixed a bug where the Second Boar was fleeing to the wrong area. - Wheelbarrow can now transport powdery materials such as clay. - Releasing the Spirit of a Mouse or a Frog now takes 3 minutes. - Fixed the bug with Boars stuck in the same area not attacking the player or doing anything else. - Fixed the Wood Sorrel has dried notification. - Fixed a bug where rain was reducing mosquitos twice. - Quern no longer shows progress durability. - Fixed a bug preventing the move from Boggy Meadows to Black Mire during the night. - Fixed a bug with inconsistencies when adding and removing powders to clay jars. - Pottery Wheel now speeds up the creation of Crucibles. - Cellar improvement no longer unlocks if you have a tree log on board. Research is now needed. - Added the new Metal version of Fire Striker to Camp Filter. - Fixed the name of the Iron Spear. - Fixed a bug where Animals bought from the trader would initially have an undefined satiation value. - Powder Salt now also removes a bit of spoilage when applied just like salt used directly from the containers already does. - Lighting a fire with a lit tinder or bracket fungus no longer increases the fuel amount. - Brain Mush, Bones and Tendons now give a tiny bit of Food when thrown into Enclosure. - Releasing a Spirit of Tiny Animals such as Birds and Fish now takes 3 minutes. - Fixed a bug where Meat Hook could be hammered more each time its rope is removed and hid its quality away since it currently has no effects. - Snow now fills up Barrels, Cisterns and Basins which are located under the open sky. - Partridges, Chickens, Boars and Cows you no longer want or need can now be released into the wild (increasing their approppriate populations). - Cows and boars can now be stacked and unstacked just like Partridges and Chickens. - Adding ingredients to a Pie no longer reduces its quality. - Crafting a fiber break now properly reduces beaver Urge. - Fixed a bug where some blueprints would always be marked as new every time you reloaded a save. - Reduced the amount of Quality loss when adding new items to the Stew and it now scales of how much thickness the item adds as well as its own quality. - Summoning Ritual now allow for Spirit Mushrooms or Fly Agaric as ingredients in place of Fairyweed. - Wheat straw, rye straw and dry meadowgrass can now be used instead of dry reeds in Fire Magic Rituals. - Chicken and Duck Carcasses can now also be used in place of Partridge Carcasses in Fox Enchantments, Summonings and Callings. - Leather scraps are now about half the weight, you need twice as many of them to stitch into a small leather and you get 4 when cutting it small leather. (Old small leathers that were made in the past should still cut into 2 though.) - Fixed the art for unplaced Iron Meat Hook. - Frostbite Wounds now heal twice as fast. - Clay jars can now store less powder than before, but light powders such as Fairyweed Powder now last considerably longer. - Fixed a bug where Wheat Straw could not be used to make an improvised bed. - Fixed a bug with Fire Striker removing its Flint away would make it increase its durability. - Fixed a bug where White Bronze Skinning Knives were displaying themselves as generic metal knives. - Fixed a bug where Witchstone vein in the Death Chamber were not mineable with pickaxes. - Fixed a bug that was preventing you from making Fly Agaric Tea from boiled Fly Agaric. - Fixed a bug where Enraged Wolf Pack would attack even when a character had the wolf protection perk. - Dry fodder can now be toggled to stack and unstack. - First Step of Flatbow construction can now use a Drawknife instead of a standard cutting tool to speed it up and increase the quality of the final product. - Added Cattail Fluff to the Camp Filter. - Renamed "Domesticated Animals Hunger Durability" to Satiation. - Increased the weight of Dry Fodder to better reflect the big amount of items it is made from. - Added the word Dirty to the name of dirty intestines, kidneys and stomachs to emphasize more that they need to be cleaned first. - Vomiting no longer reduces morale directly but significantly reduces gratification instead. - Updated the description of the Log Piece. - Alder Bark can now be used to make Bark Sandals. - Fixed a bug where bears, wolves and the moontouched would not drop a carcass when killed. - FIxed a bug where too much liquid ash and quick lime was getting destroyed when used from a container on garden plots. - Boars and other animals now prioritize food lying around in the area before going for gardens, fields or domesticated animals. - Partridges eat small and tiny foods before big ones. - Fixed a bug where the Moontouched would be Tranquilized after every combat regardless of whether the player hit him with a Poisoned Weapon or not. - Survival Gear Perk now starts you with a new metal version of Fire Striker and a piece of Flint instead of the old Fire Striker with Flint. - Fixed a bug where stomach would get absorbed into the stew after only 15 minutes. - Fertilizer can now be transformed into its "liquid" form by putting it inside an empty sack, storage pot or a similar container that can hold "liquid" powders. - Combing fibers with a hackle now gives weaving skill instead of tailoring. - Fixed a bug where Oak Blight would check for Boar population instead of Doe population when slowing down the Doe and Stag respawn rate. - Weighted Loom, Threadle Loom and the Spinning Wheel now all add some Sanctuary to the location. - Reworked how metal tools and weapon blueprints are researched (researching the tool automatically unlocks its blanks and casts without further research). - Made improvements to powders to make them more consistent with each other. - Sacks can no longer be filled with Water. - Reduced the Weaving skill required to unlock Hackle, Funnel Trap, Bark Sandals and Weighted Loom to be in line with recent changes to Weaving skill gains. - Reduced the Weaving Skill gain when crafting Funnel Traps and Bark Sandals to be in line with how much you gain when making Baskets or Reed Clothing. - Making ropes now gives Weaving Skill. - Fixed a bug where the oven would still sometimes give charcoal when running out of fuel. - Fixed a bug in the Mosquito Flats North Travel action when its path is frozen or flooded which was taking you to the wrong place. - Swamp Start Perk now gives you alder instead of oak wood. - Garden Plot Inspect Action now has a tooltip when it cant be performed. - Fixed a bug where the Garden Plot could not be destroyed if Care was higher than 0. - Fixed a bug where the bear cave exit would not spawn. - Fixed a bug where blueprint cards would say "X does not have enough of Y" when drag and dropping the wrong ingredient. - Saves that were broken with empty locations should now fix themselves as you play. - Fixed the animal and metal trader initial dialog linking into the general trader dialog tree. - Drinking Water from Containers no longer takes time. - Cooking Pot Blueprint is now properly affected by the Pottery Wheel. - Fixed an exploit where you could take 10 ash items from a container when there are only 2 inside. - Extinguished Kilns no longer accept dry leaves as fuel. - Fixed a bug which prevented Hare Leather from being trimmed. - New Huntsman runs now start with Wolf Protection Perk. - Placed Fiber Break now gives 25 sanctuary. - Fixed a bug where new environments would sometimes be empty, locking the player. - Reduced the unlock requirements for Reed Coat, Spindle, Fiber Break and Spinning Wheel. - Stag Carcasses now drop antlers when they spoil or get consumed by animals. - Fixed an issue where the Morale Status bar and the morale detailed description screen where showing conflicting information. - Fixed the art for the Handsaw shape in the Handsaw tool blueprint. - Knife Sheath can now be renamed. - Fish scraps now give proper nutrients and can be used in stews. - Bog Myrtle Leaves can now be used in stews. - Improved the description for Arrowhead blanks and shapes. - "Remake Iron Bar" recipe now accepts both unfinished and finished tool and weapon heads. - Removed the max stack size for twigs when collecting resources. - Smith Perk now starts with Forge and Bloomery completely unlocked. - Reduced the amount of Pottery Skill required to unlock a Pottery Wheel. - Reduced the penalty to skill gain for Weaving and Pottery when making items you already made and penalty now gets reduced after some time has passed. - Crafting Twine, Yarn, Small Cloth, Medium Cloth and Large Cloth now gives Weaving Skill instead of Tailoring. - Tailoring skill gain penalty now gets reduced after some time has passed. - Reduced the material cost for Cloth Sack from 2 Large Clothes to a single one. - Workbench no longer speeds up the crafting of Yarns or Twine when using a Spinning wheel. - Workbench no longer speeds up making Pottery out of Clay. - Fiber break, Spinning Wheel and Treadle Loom can now be placed and picked up and only works if placed in a location. - Iron Handsaw now has a lot less durability than axes and is worse than metal axes when cutting down small trees and brushwood. - Fixed the Heather Stems Dried message. - Fixed the Cloth Sack name. - Added the Heated Version art for Iron Fire Striker. - Fixed some instances of environments not properly loading and the game getting stuck with no environment card. And... that's all for now! We'll be tweaking all these new systems quite a bit, so expect lots of hotfixes over the following weeks. ;) Please let us know if there are any specific duties or traits, physical or mental, that you would like us to add and we'll do our best to add them as soon as possible! Until the next update! Reminder: All fixes and new content are added to the public beta branch first. If you want to access them you can find the instructions on the link below. Be warned though, things are less stable there and are likely to undergo balance changes quite frequently! :) https://steamcommunity.com/app/2868860/discussions/0/600774299444324511/
contents.Text: 免责声明：本公告由机器翻译生成，若术语有误，敬请谅解。 大家好！ 终于到了在《Card Survival: Fantasy Forest》中加入人类 NPC 的时刻了。 首先要说明的是，这对我们来说是一次重大更新，也是迄今为止规模最大的一次。 对于测试版（beta branch）中的各位勇敢玩家，请知悉：NPC 涉及复杂的系统，而在有限的时间内，Neo 和我能进行的测试毕竟有限。虽然我们未发现重大 Bug 或问题，但难免会有漏网之鱼，且数值平衡方面也仍需大量调整。 :) 在接下来的几周里，我们将陆续发布一系列热修复补丁，涵盖 Bug 修复、平衡性微调以及补全一些缺失的小功能。 此外，NPC 系统相当复杂，部分机制初看可能会让大多数玩家感到有些晦涩难懂。我们会致力于让这些内容变得更清晰、更易于理解。 目前，我们将尽力在这篇公告中为大家详细解读。 另外，本次更新暂不包含美术资源。由于工作量巨大，我实在无暇为 NPC 绘制专属立绘。好在我们支持上传自定义头像，所以这应该不是什么大问题。 :) 等我有时间了，会陆续加入一些官方美术素材！ 现在，让我们来聊聊具体的 NPC 内容。 人类 NPC： 在游戏中，人类 NPC 被称为“伙伴”（partners），你可以通过特质（perks）选择他们，也可以向商人请求招募他们。 你可以创建自己的自定义伙伴，也可以选择现有的伙伴（并对其进行编辑）。 我们提供了 6 种伙伴预设： - 工匠（The Craftsman）：一位和善且乐于助人的丈夫。 - 梦想家（The Dreamer）：一位不太勤劳但更浪漫的伙伴。 - 桀骜者（The Untamed）：一位独立自主的男性。 - 贤内助（The Hearthwife）：一位和善且乐于助人的妻子。 - 活力派（The Spirited）：一位更具冒险精神的伙伴，适合结伴探险。 - 缪斯（The Muse）：一位美丽却难以相处的伙伴，起初并不会提供太多实质性帮助。 建议你从“工匠（Craftsman）”或“持家者（Hearthwife）”开始体验。:) 其他伙伴的难度较高，平衡性尚需优化，且缺少一些能赋予其独特个性的功能。 伙伴们会进食、饮水和睡眠，并能以多种方式协助你。他们可以进行剥皮、刮肉、鞣制、屠宰、打扫房屋、照看火堆、整理床铺、觅食、收集木柴、砍伐树木、采集泥土、制作泥砖或粘土、照料花园、收割作物等工作。 他们还会根据舒适度和气温自动穿戴衣物；当然，如果长期疏于照料，他们可能会因饥饿或失温而死亡，甚至离你而去。 职责系统： 伙伴通过一种基于情境的职责系统来提供协助。 目前，这些职责主要分为两大类。 标记职责： 游戏中的许多物品都可以被标记以执行特定职责。例如，你可以将一处火堆标记为“照看火堆（firekeeping）”对象，这样伙伴就会负责维护该火堆，确保其燃料充足，不会熄灭。 值得注意的是，某些职责的执行需要相应的工具。例如，虽然可以将动物尸体标记为“剥皮”对象，但伙伴只有在持有刀具时才会进行剥皮操作。 以下是目前可用的部分标记职责： - 照看火堆 - 整理床铺 - 打扫房屋 - 采集泥土 - 收割作物（包括野外植被和农田作物） - 园艺照料 - 觅食 - 收集木柴 - 剥皮 - 刮肉 - 屠宰 - 砍伐树木 物品栏职责： 当伙伴对你的感激度达到一定水平时，若持有相应工具，他们便会自动处理物品栏中的物品。 例如，他们会将物品栏中的荨麻茎加工成纤维，并进一步将纤维加工成麻绳。或者，如果他们的物品栏中有锤击工具，也可以研磨各种干燥草药。 如果你不希望他们处理这些事务，可以通过对话关闭物品栏相关的工作任务。 以下是目前可用的部分物品栏工作任务清单： - 提取纤维 - 制作绳索 - 捶打筋腱 - 制作肉血混合馅料 - 制作泥砖 - 制作黏土 - 鱼类去脏处理 - 宰杀小型动物 - 研磨草药 - 压制奶酪 好感度： 伙伴和玩家角色一样，并非机器；若想让他们留下来、提供协助甚至生存下去，就必须善待他们。 “好感度”是这一系统的核心。好感度会根据 NPC 对你的满意程度随时间积累，并在他们为你完成任务时消耗。 好感度越高，伙伴执行任务的意愿就越强；反之，好感度越低，他们提供的协助也就越少。 切记不要在初期对伙伴要求过多，否则他们很快就会心生怨气。 根据伙伴的性格，最好循序渐进：先安排少量简单任务（最好是他们喜欢的），随着他们对你信任度的加深，再逐渐增加工作量。 此外……如果发现伙伴开始产生怨气，最好暂停指派给他们的任务，这样他们的“好感度”才有机会恢复。 偏好： 伙伴拥有不同的性格和喜好。这会影响他们积累好感度的速度、执行特定任务的意愿以及任务对他们的消耗程度。例如，有的伙伴可能喜欢讲究条理的精细活，而另一些则更偏好体力劳动。 目前游戏中包含以下几类职责： - 精细活（Methodical）：织布、研磨等…… - 体力活（Physical）：伐木、劈柴、屠宰等…… - 照料类（Nurturing）：维护火堆、打理花园、清洁等…… - 创造类（Creative）：演奏音乐、木雕等…… - 自然类（Nature）：收集木材、采集野果等…… 许多职责并不局限于单一类别，而是跨越多个类别。 关系系统： 伙伴和玩家一样，拥有复杂的生理与心理状态系统。他们有满足感、健康状况、士气、饥饿度、食欲、饱腹感等各项指标。 尽管某些系统（如免疫系统）尚未实装，但现有的机制已足以支撑他们正常运作。 伙伴系统的核心在于互助：你帮助他们，他们也会回报你。但这需要建立在信任的基础上。 信任的建立需要时间，取决于伙伴的性格特征、感激之情、对你的好感度以及你对待他们的方式。 当信任度达到一定水平后，好感度便会开始提升，事情也会变得更加顺利。随着伙伴积累的好感度增加，他们能投入的精力也更多，从而能提供更大的帮助。 其他因素也起着重要作用。例如，如果伙伴对你产生了好感，甚至发展为迷恋，这能显著加快好感度和信任度的积累，因为他们会表现出对你更浓厚的兴趣。 关系发展通常遵循以下过程： - 伙伴建立信任，直到对你感到安心自在。 - 伙伴开始对你产生好感。 - 如果伙伴对你产生吸引力，可能会进一步发展为迷恋，此时各种互动会变得更加容易。 对话系统： 与伴侣沟通并给予关注，对于维持他们的好心情至关重要。 你和伴侣都拥有一项名为“联结度”（connection）的数值，该数值会随时间推移而下降，只能通过与他人沟通来提升。 当联结度降低时，伴侣会渴望得到关注；如果你长时间不与他们交谈，他们便会感到被冷落。 为了留出想象空间并降低文本编写的复杂度，我们将该系统设计为基于抽象层面的运作模式。简单来说，你只需选择想要表达的抽象意图（如感激、爱意、吸引力、需求等），伴侣便会根据双方的各项数值互动情况，做出正面或负面的反应。 针对伴侣的对话主要分为两个窗口：“表达”（Expression）和“指令”（Direction）。 指令： “指令”是一个简单且侧重于实用功能的菜单，你可以通过它要求伴侣执行以下操作： 跟随/停止跟随： 此指令让伴侣持续跟随你或停止跟随。跟随动作会消耗少量好感度，请务必留意这一点，尤其是对于那些容易产生怨气的伴侣。 设为家： 这至关重要。你应该始终将自己的房屋或营地标记为“家”。这样，当伴侣停止跟随你，或完成离开你身边的任务后，便会自动返回此处。 处理/停止处理物品： 此指令用于切换伴侣对物品栏的处理任务。如果伴侣正在协助你搬运你不希望被其加工处理的货物，这项功能就显得尤为重要。 表达： 这是主要的对话菜单，也是大部分交流发生的地方。 在这里，你与伴侣进行沟通，互动的最终结果取决于你和伴侣各自的数值状态。有效的沟通并非必然，如果玩家频繁进行互动或表达了不恰当的内容，很容易导致气氛尴尬或惹恼伴侣。 社交技巧、吸引力水平、果断程度、同理心、信任度、爱意以及其他因素，都在很大程度上决定了每次互动的走向。 此外，还有一项名为“尴尬度”（awkwardness）的数值，它在互动中起着尤为关键的作用。这种情绪会在互动失败或反复互动时累积；一旦数值过高，往往会搞砸后续的沟通尝试。因此，如果你发现某次互动失败了，不妨先暂停一下，等到对方不再感到尴尬（可通过查看其“详情”标签页来确认）后再尝试进一步交流。 “表达”菜单中提供了多种沟通方式： 闲聊： 这是一个相对稳妥的选择。引发尴尬的风险较低，但通常收益也较小。它主要用于维系关系，特别是在关系建立初期——当你既想关注对方，又不想冒互动失败的风险时，这便是个不错的选择。 倾听： 位于“表达关怀”子菜单下。这也是一种低风险的互动方式，但…………对伴侣产生更大的影响。这是最值得常用的互动之一，尤其是在面对较难相处的伴侣时，但需要高度集中注意力才能奏效。 表达感激： 同样位于“表达关怀”子菜单中。最好在好感度较低时使用。当伴侣产生些许怨气（但怨气未深，也未感到特别感激）时，此举最容易奏效。 表达爱意： 这也是“表达关怀”选项之一。这是一种良好的互动，但通常只有在双方已建立真挚感情后才有效。 表达吸引力与亲密感： 这两个互动只有在双方存在相互吸引的情况下才真正有效；一旦未来能够组建家庭，它们将发挥更重要的作用。 表达寻求帮助的需求： 此互动即请求伴侣提供更多协助；若成功，将大幅提升好感度。不过，若失败则可能引起对方反感。 表达寻求情感支持的需求： 若此互动成功，伴侣将协助你恢复部分士气。 以上是目前的可用选项，但我们在未来几个月内会对其进行调整并增加更多选项。 伴侣的自我表达 伴侣也会主动表达自己的感受。例如，当他们感到饥饿、被冷落、产生吸引力或感激之情时，都会向你传达这些信息。 未来我们将在此增加更多选项，赋予伴侣更高的自主性，让他们显得更加鲜活生动。 伴侣创建： 伴侣拥有各自的特质（Perks），就像玩家角色一样。 你可以通过“自定义伴侣特质”从零开始构建，也可以通过修改现有预设角色的特质来进行调整。 性格： 伴侣的性格会显著影响你的互动体验。通过这些特质，你可以决定他们偏好的职责类型、乐于助人的程度，以及与他们建立关系进展的快慢。 吸引力： 吸引力至关重要，因此你需要确保伴侣与你的角色相契合——当然，除非你想要增加一些挑战难度。 《Fantasy Forest》中的伴侣并非“无条件迎合玩家”（即不一定对所有玩家角色都产生好感），所以如果你希望伴侣对你的角色产生吸引力，就必须确保双方的特质相匹配。 外貌：** 游戏会追踪伴侣的诸多外貌特征，涵盖从头发长度、颜色和类型，到臀部或肩部宽度、下颌大小以及双眼间距等各项细节。这些特征不仅让伴侣显得更加真实立体，还会切实影响他们的吸引力数值以及男性化或女性化特质。 值得一提的是，部分外貌特征可以通过“特质（perks）”直接设定，而另一些特征则会受到激素水平、身高和体重等因素的影响，从而间接显现出来。 知识：** “知识”类特质能赋予伴侣相应的技能。虽然目前伴侣尚无与“职责系统”直接挂钩的技能，导致这些特质暂时无法发挥实际效用，但你现在就可以为他们装备这些特质，以便为未来的功能更新做好准备。 NPC 的未来展望：** 本次更新仅仅是 NPC 系统发展的第一步。 我们已制定了详尽的计划，并将在接下来的几个月内陆续推出各项新内容。 值得期待的重磅更新包括： 更多“标记”与“库存”类职责：** 新增大量丰富伴侣活动的职责，包括锻造、演奏音乐和雕刻等。 远征职责：** 这是一类复杂的职责，伴侣将离开一段时间去执行任务，并在完成后返回。 此类职责的例子包括长途采集、检查陷阱、捕鱼和狩猎。 标记蓝图：** 你可以创建蓝图，让伴侣代为完成建造工作。这对于修建道路或房屋等耗资巨大且工序繁多的任务尤为实用。 烹饪职责：** 一种全新的复杂职责类型，伴侣将负责处理食材，并为自己和你烹饪食物。 战斗： 伙伴可参与战斗，让对抗更危险的敌人变得相对轻松一些。 组建家庭： 伙伴可以怀孕（或让你怀孕），以及经历婴儿、幼儿、儿童和青少年等成长阶段。 全新高级NPC： 猎犬、驮畜、魔宠、人类旅者与猎人，以及改良后的商人。 伙伴死亡机制： 伙伴可能生病或受伤，并因伤势过重而死亡。 对话系统改进： 对话系统全面升级，包含多项提升游戏体验的优化及大量新增选项。 EA_0.66版本及自上次公告以来的更新日志： - 修复了一个漏洞：当容器内仅有2个灰烬（ash）物品时，玩家却能从中取出10个。 - 熄灭状态的窑炉不再接受干树叶作为燃料。 - 修复了无法对野兔皮（Hare Leather）进行裁剪的错误。 - 新的“猎人（Huntsman）”开局现在会自带“狼群防护（Wolf Protection）”特质。 - 放置后的纤维处理台（Fiber Break）现在提供25点庇护值（sanctuary）。 - 修复了新环境有时会生成为空白导致玩家被卡住的错误。 - 降低了芦苇外套（Reed Coat）、纺锤（Spindle）、纤维处理台（Fiber Break）和纺车（Spinning Wheel）的解锁要求。 - 雄鹿尸体在腐烂或被动物吃掉时，现在会掉落鹿角。 - 修复了士气状态条与士气详细描述界面显示信息不一致的问题。 - 修正了手锯（Handsaw）工具蓝图中手锯形状的视觉表现。 - 刀鞘（Knife Sheath）现在可以重命名。 - 鱼类碎料（Fish scraps）现在能提供正确的营养值，并可用于炖菜。 - 沼泽香桃木叶（Bog Myrtle Leaves）现在可用于炖菜。 - 改进了箭头毛坯（Arrowhead blanks）和形状（shapes）的描述。 - “重制铁锭（Remake Iron Bar）”配方现在接受未完成或已完成的工具及武器头部作为材料。 - 移除了收集资源时细枝（twigs）的最大堆叠数量限制。 - “铁匠（Smith）”特质现在开局即完全解锁锻造炉（Forge）和块炼炉（Bloomery）。 - 降低了解锁陶轮（Pottery Wheel）所需的陶艺技能等级。 - 降低了重复制作已制作过的物品时，织造（Weaving）和陶艺（Pottery）技能获取的惩罚；且该惩罚会随时间推移而减轻。 - 制作麻绳（Twine）、纱线（Yarn）及各种尺寸的布料（小、中、大）现在提升织造技能，而非裁缝技能。 - 裁缝技能获取的惩罚现在会随时间推移而减轻。 - 将布袋（Cloth Sack）的材料消耗从2块大布料降低为1块。 - 使用纺车（Spinning Wheel）时，工作台（Workbench）不再加速纱线或麻绳的制作。 - 使用粘土制作陶器时，工作台不再提供加速效果。 - 纤维处理台、纺车和脚踏织布机（Treadle Loom）现在可以放置和回收，且仅在放置于场景中时生效。 - 铁制手锯的耐久度远低于斧头；在砍伐小树和灌木丛时，其效率也不如金属斧头。 - 修正了“干燥的石楠花茎”（Heather Stems Dried）的提示信息。 - 修正了“布袋”（Cloth Sack）的名称。 - 为“铁制打火器”（Iron Fire Striker）添加了“加热状态”下的美术素材。 - 修复了部分环境下场景无法正常加载，导致游戏因缺失环境卡牌而卡死的问题。 以上就是本次更新的全部内容！ 我们将对这些新系统进行持续微调，因此未来几周可能会频繁发布热修复补丁。;) 如果您希望我们添加特定的职责或特性（无论是生理还是心理层面的），请告诉我们，我们会尽力尽快将其加入游戏中！ 期待下次更新再见！ 温馨提示：所有修复内容和新功能都会先在公开测试分支（public beta branch）上线。 如果您想体验这些内容，可以查看下方链接中的说明。不过请注意，测试分支的稳定性相对较低，且游戏平衡性可能会频繁调整！:) https://steamcommunity.com/app/2868860/discussions/0/600774299444324511/
contents.zh: 免责声明：本公告由机器翻译生成，若术语有误，敬请谅解。 大家好！ 终于到了在《Card Survival: Fantasy Forest》中加入人类 NPC 的时刻了。 首先要说明的是，这对我们来说是一次重大更新，也是迄今为止规模最大的一次。 对于测试版（beta branch）中的各位勇敢玩家，请知悉：NPC 涉及复杂的系统，而在有限的时间内，Neo 和我能进行的测试毕竟有限。虽然我们未发现重大 Bug 或问题，但难免会有漏网之鱼，且数值平衡方面也仍需大量调整。 :) 在接下来的几周里，我们将陆续发布一系列热修复补丁，涵盖 Bug 修复、平衡性微调以及补全一些缺失的小功能。 此外，NPC 系统相当复杂，部分机制初看可能会让大多数玩家感到有些晦涩难懂。我们会致力于让这些内容变得更清晰、更易于理解。 目前，我们将尽力在这篇公告中为大家详细解读。 另外，本次更新暂不包含美术资源。由于工作量巨大，我实在无暇为 NPC 绘制专属立绘。好在我们支持上传自定义头像，所以这应该不是什么大问题。 :) 等我有时间了，会陆续加入一些官方美术素材！ 现在，让我们来聊聊具体的 NPC 内容。 人类 NPC： 在游戏中，人类 NPC 被称为“伙伴”（partners），你可以通过特质（perks）选择他们，也可以向商人请求招募他们。 你可以创建自己的自定义伙伴，也可以选择现有的伙伴（并对其进行编辑）。 我们提供了 6 种伙伴预设： - 工匠（The Craftsman）：一位和善且乐于助人的丈夫。 - 梦想家（The Dreamer）：一位不太勤劳但更浪漫的伙伴。 - 桀骜者（The Untamed）：一位独立自主的男性。 - 贤内助（The Hearthwife）：一位和善且乐于助人的妻子。 - 活力派（The Spirited）：一位更具冒险精神的伙伴，适合结伴探险。 - 缪斯（The Muse）：一位美丽却难以相处的伙伴，起初并不会提供太多实质性帮助。 建议你从“工匠（Craftsman）”或“持家者（Hearthwife）”开始体验。:) 其他伙伴的难度较高，平衡性尚需优化，且缺少一些能赋予其独特个性的功能。 伙伴们会进食、饮水和睡眠，并能以多种方式协助你。他们可以进行剥皮、刮肉、鞣制、屠宰、打扫房屋、照看火堆、整理床铺、觅食、收集木柴、砍伐树木、采集泥土、制作泥砖或粘土、照料花园、收割作物等工作。 他们还会根据舒适度和气温自动穿戴衣物；当然，如果长期疏于照料，他们可能会因饥饿或失温而死亡，甚至离你而去。 职责系统： 伙伴通过一种基于情境的职责系统来提供协助。 目前，这些职责主要分为两大类。 标记职责： 游戏中的许多物品都可以被标记以执行特定职责。例如，你可以将一处火堆标记为“照看火堆（firekeeping）”对象，这样伙伴就会负责维护该火堆，确保其燃料充足，不会熄灭。 值得注意的是，某些职责的执行需要相应的工具。例如，虽然可以将动物尸体标记为“剥皮”对象，但伙伴只有在持有刀具时才会进行剥皮操作。 以下是目前可用的部分标记职责： - 照看火堆 - 整理床铺 - 打扫房屋 - 采集泥土 - 收割作物（包括野外植被和农田作物） - 园艺照料 - 觅食 - 收集木柴 - 剥皮 - 刮肉 - 屠宰 - 砍伐树木 物品栏职责： 当伙伴对你的感激度达到一定水平时，若持有相应工具，他们便会自动处理物品栏中的物品。 例如，他们会将物品栏中的荨麻茎加工成纤维，并进一步将纤维加工成麻绳。或者，如果他们的物品栏中有锤击工具，也可以研磨各种干燥草药。 如果你不希望他们处理这些事务，可以通过对话关闭物品栏相关的工作任务。 以下是目前可用的部分物品栏工作任务清单： - 提取纤维 - 制作绳索 - 捶打筋腱 - 制作肉血混合馅料 - 制作泥砖 - 制作黏土 - 鱼类去脏处理 - 宰杀小型动物 - 研磨草药 - 压制奶酪 好感度： 伙伴和玩家角色一样，并非机器；若想让他们留下来、提供协助甚至生存下去，就必须善待他们。 “好感度”是这一系统的核心。好感度会根据 NPC 对你的满意程度随时间积累，并在他们为你完成任务时消耗。 好感度越高，伙伴执行任务的意愿就越强；反之，好感度越低，他们提供的协助也就越少。 切记不要在初期对伙伴要求过多，否则他们很快就会心生怨气。 根据伙伴的性格，最好循序渐进：先安排少量简单任务（最好是他们喜欢的），随着他们对你信任度的加深，再逐渐增加工作量。 此外……如果发现伙伴开始产生怨气，最好暂停指派给他们的任务，这样他们的“好感度”才有机会恢复。 偏好： 伙伴拥有不同的性格和喜好。这会影响他们积累好感度的速度、执行特定任务的意愿以及任务对他们的消耗程度。例如，有的伙伴可能喜欢讲究条理的精细活，而另一些则更偏好体力劳动。 目前游戏中包含以下几类职责： - 精细活（Methodical）：织布、研磨等…… - 体力活（Physical）：伐木、劈柴、屠宰等…… - 照料类（Nurturing）：维护火堆、打理花园、清洁等…… - 创造类（Creative）：演奏音乐、木雕等…… - 自然类（Nature）：收集木材、采集野果等…… 许多职责并不局限于单一类别，而是跨越多个类别。 关系系统： 伙伴和玩家一样，拥有复杂的生理与心理状态系统。他们有满足感、健康状况、士气、饥饿度、食欲、饱腹感等各项指标。 尽管某些系统（如免疫系统）尚未实装，但现有的机制已足以支撑他们正常运作。 伙伴系统的核心在于互助：你帮助他们，他们也会回报你。但这需要建立在信任的基础上。 信任的建立需要时间，取决于伙伴的性格特征、感激之情、对你的好感度以及你对待他们的方式。 当信任度达到一定水平后，好感度便会开始提升，事情也会变得更加顺利。随着伙伴积累的好感度增加，他们能投入的精力也更多，从而能提供更大的帮助。 其他因素也起着重要作用。例如，如果伙伴对你产生了好感，甚至发展为迷恋，这能显著加快好感度和信任度的积累，因为他们会表现出对你更浓厚的兴趣。 关系发展通常遵循以下过程： - 伙伴建立信任，直到对你感到安心自在。 - 伙伴开始对你产生好感。 - 如果伙伴对你产生吸引力，可能会进一步发展为迷恋，此时各种互动会变得更加容易。 对话系统： 与伴侣沟通并给予关注，对于维持他们的好心情至关重要。 你和伴侣都拥有一项名为“联结度”（connection）的数值，该数值会随时间推移而下降，只能通过与他人沟通来提升。 当联结度降低时，伴侣会渴望得到关注；如果你长时间不与他们交谈，他们便会感到被冷落。 为了留出想象空间并降低文本编写的复杂度，我们将该系统设计为基于抽象层面的运作模式。简单来说，你只需选择想要表达的抽象意图（如感激、爱意、吸引力、需求等），伴侣便会根据双方的各项数值互动情况，做出正面或负面的反应。 针对伴侣的对话主要分为两个窗口：“表达”（Expression）和“指令”（Direction）。 指令： “指令”是一个简单且侧重于实用功能的菜单，你可以通过它要求伴侣执行以下操作： 跟随/停止跟随： 此指令让伴侣持续跟随你或停止跟随。跟随动作会消耗少量好感度，请务必留意这一点，尤其是对于那些容易产生怨气的伴侣。 设为家： 这至关重要。你应该始终将自己的房屋或营地标记为“家”。这样，当伴侣停止跟随你，或完成离开你身边的任务后，便会自动返回此处。 处理/停止处理物品： 此指令用于切换伴侣对物品栏的处理任务。如果伴侣正在协助你搬运你不希望被其加工处理的货物，这项功能就显得尤为重要。 表达： 这是主要的对话菜单，也是大部分交流发生的地方。 在这里，你与伴侣进行沟通，互动的最终结果取决于你和伴侣各自的数值状态。有效的沟通并非必然，如果玩家频繁进行互动或表达了不恰当的内容，很容易导致气氛尴尬或惹恼伴侣。 社交技巧、吸引力水平、果断程度、同理心、信任度、爱意以及其他因素，都在很大程度上决定了每次互动的走向。 此外，还有一项名为“尴尬度”（awkwardness）的数值，它在互动中起着尤为关键的作用。这种情绪会在互动失败或反复互动时累积；一旦数值过高，往往会搞砸后续的沟通尝试。因此，如果你发现某次互动失败了，不妨先暂停一下，等到对方不再感到尴尬（可通过查看其“详情”标签页来确认）后再尝试进一步交流。 “表达”菜单中提供了多种沟通方式： 闲聊： 这是一个相对稳妥的选择。引发尴尬的风险较低，但通常收益也较小。它主要用于维系关系，特别是在关系建立初期——当你既想关注对方，又不想冒互动失败的风险时，这便是个不错的选择。 倾听： 位于“表达关怀”子菜单下。这也是一种低风险的互动方式，但…………对伴侣产生更大的影响。这是最值得常用的互动之一，尤其是在面对较难相处的伴侣时，但需要高度集中注意力才能奏效。 表达感激： 同样位于“表达关怀”子菜单中。最好在好感度较低时使用。当伴侣产生些许怨气（但怨气未深，也未感到特别感激）时，此举最容易奏效。 表达爱意： 这也是“表达关怀”选项之一。这是一种良好的互动，但通常只有在双方已建立真挚感情后才有效。 表达吸引力与亲密感： 这两个互动只有在双方存在相互吸引的情况下才真正有效；一旦未来能够组建家庭，它们将发挥更重要的作用。 表达寻求帮助的需求： 此互动即请求伴侣提供更多协助；若成功，将大幅提升好感度。不过，若失败则可能引起对方反感。 表达寻求情感支持的需求： 若此互动成功，伴侣将协助你恢复部分士气。 以上是目前的可用选项，但我们在未来几个月内会对其进行调整并增加更多选项。 伴侣的自我表达 伴侣也会主动表达自己的感受。例如，当他们感到饥饿、被冷落、产生吸引力或感激之情时，都会向你传达这些信息。 未来我们将在此增加更多选项，赋予伴侣更高的自主性，让他们显得更加鲜活生动。 伴侣创建： 伴侣拥有各自的特质（Perks），就像玩家角色一样。 你可以通过“自定义伴侣特质”从零开始构建，也可以通过修改现有预设角色的特质来进行调整。 性格： 伴侣的性格会显著影响你的互动体验。通过这些特质，你可以决定他们偏好的职责类型、乐于助人的程度，以及与他们建立关系进展的快慢。 吸引力： 吸引力至关重要，因此你需要确保伴侣与你的角色相契合——当然，除非你想要增加一些挑战难度。 《Fantasy Forest》中的伴侣并非“无条件迎合玩家”（即不一定对所有玩家角色都产生好感），所以如果你希望伴侣对你的角色产生吸引力，就必须确保双方的特质相匹配。 外貌：** 游戏会追踪伴侣的诸多外貌特征，涵盖从头发长度、颜色和类型，到臀部或肩部宽度、下颌大小以及双眼间距等各项细节。这些特征不仅让伴侣显得更加真实立体，还会切实影响他们的吸引力数值以及男性化或女性化特质。 值得一提的是，部分外貌特征可以通过“特质（perks）”直接设定，而另一些特征则会受到激素水平、身高和体重等因素的影响，从而间接显现出来。 知识：** “知识”类特质能赋予伴侣相应的技能。虽然目前伴侣尚无与“职责系统”直接挂钩的技能，导致这些特质暂时无法发挥实际效用，但你现在就可以为他们装备这些特质，以便为未来的功能更新做好准备。 NPC 的未来展望：** 本次更新仅仅是 NPC 系统发展的第一步。 我们已制定了详尽的计划，并将在接下来的几个月内陆续推出各项新内容。 值得期待的重磅更新包括： 更多“标记”与“库存”类职责：** 新增大量丰富伴侣活动的职责，包括锻造、演奏音乐和雕刻等。 远征职责：** 这是一类复杂的职责，伴侣将离开一段时间去执行任务，并在完成后返回。 此类职责的例子包括长途采集、检查陷阱、捕鱼和狩猎。 标记蓝图：** 你可以创建蓝图，让伴侣代为完成建造工作。这对于修建道路或房屋等耗资巨大且工序繁多的任务尤为实用。 烹饪职责：** 一种全新的复杂职责类型，伴侣将负责处理食材，并为自己和你烹饪食物。 战斗： 伙伴可参与战斗，让对抗更危险的敌人变得相对轻松一些。 组建家庭： 伙伴可以怀孕（或让你怀孕），以及经历婴儿、幼儿、儿童和青少年等成长阶段。 全新高级NPC： 猎犬、驮畜、魔宠、人类旅者与猎人，以及改良后的商人。 伙伴死亡机制： 伙伴可能生病或受伤，并因伤势过重而死亡。 对话系统改进： 对话系统全面升级，包含多项提升游戏体验的优化及大量新增选项。 EA_0.66版本及自上次公告以来的更新日志： - 新增伙伴创建功能及相关特性。 - 新增复杂的职责分配系统。 - 新增伙伴的生理、心理、吸引力及社交系统。 - 新增6种伙伴预设。 - 新增向普通商人请求获取伙伴的功能。 - 新增NPC装备系统。 - 血液现在会直接凝固成固态血块。 - 修复了面粉和谷物无法在地窖及容器中正常保存的错误。- 修复了“第二只野猪”逃往错误区域的错误。 - 独轮车现在可以运输粘土等粉末状材料。 - 释放老鼠或青蛙的灵魂现在需要3分钟。 - 修复了野猪卡在同一区域既不攻击玩家也不做其他动作的错误。 - 修复了“酢浆草已干燥”的提示问题。 - 修复了雨水导致蚊子数量减少两次的错误。 - 手摇磨盘不再显示进度或耐久度。 - 修复了夜间无法从“沼泽草甸”（Boggy Meadows）移动到“黑色泥沼”（Black Mire）的错误。 - 修复了向粘土罐添加或取出粉末时出现不一致的错误。 - 陶轮现在可以加快坩埚的制作速度。 - 携带原木时不再自动解锁地窖升级；现在需要进行研究。 - 在营地过滤器（Camp Filter）中新增了金属版打火石。 - 修正了铁矛的名称。 - 修复了从商人处购买的动物初始饱食度数值未定义的问题。 - 粉末状的盐现在也能像直接使用盐那样，在施用时去除少量腐败度。 - 使用点燃的火绒或多孔菌（bracket fungus）生火时，不再增加燃料量。 - 将脑浆、骨头和肌腱扔进围栏时，现在会提供少量的食物值。 - 释放鸟类和鱼类等小型动物的灵魂现在需要3分钟。 - 修复了肉钩在每次移除绳索后可被反复敲打的问题，并隐藏了其质量显示（因该属性目前无实际效果）。 - 露天放置的木桶、蓄水池和水盆现在会自动积满积雪。 - 不再需要的鹧鸪、鸡、野猪和牛现在可以放归野外（从而增加相应物种的种群数量）。 - 牛和野猪现在可以像鹧鸪和鸡一样进行堆叠和拆分。 - 向馅饼中添加配料不再降低其质量。 - 制作纤维断裂（fiber break）现在能正确降低海狸的冲动值（Urge）。 - 修复了某些蓝图在每次重新加载存档时总被标记为“新”的错误。 - 减少了向炖菜中添加新食材时造成的品质损失；现在的品质计算不仅取决于食材自身的品质，还取决于该食材增加的浓稠度。 - 召唤仪式现在允许使用“灵菇”（Spirit Mushrooms）或“毒蝇伞”（Fly Agaric）作为替代“仙女草”（Fairyweed）的材料。 - 在火焰魔法仪式中，现在可以使用小麦秸秆、黑麦秸秆和干草甸草来替代干芦苇。 - 在针对狐狸的附魔、召唤和呼唤仪式中，现在可以使用鸡或鸭的尸体来替代鹧鸪尸体。 - 皮革碎片的重量减半；现在需要两倍数量的碎片才能缝制成一块小皮革，而将小皮革切碎时会得到 4 块碎片（不过，此前制作的小皮革切碎后仍会得到 2 块碎片）。 - 修复了未放置状态下的铁制肉钩的图像显示问题。 - 冻伤伤口的愈合速度现在提高了一倍。 - 陶罐现在能储存的粉末量减少了，但像仙女草粉末这类轻质粉末的储存时长显著增加。 - 修复了小麦秸秆无法用于制作简易床铺的错误。 - 修复了移除打火石（Flint）会导致打火器（Fire Striker）耐久度增加的错误。 - 修复了白青铜剥皮刀显示为普通金属刀具的错误。 - 修复了“死亡密室”（Death Chamber）中的巫术石（Witchstone）矿脉无法用十字镐开采的错误。 - 修复了无法用煮熟的毒蝇伞制作毒蝇伞茶的错误。 - 修复了即使角色拥有“狼群保护”特质，狂暴狼群仍会发起攻击的错误。 - 干草料现在可以切换堆叠或取消堆叠状态。 - 制作扁平弓（Flatbow）的第一步工序现在可以使用刮刀（Drawknife）代替普通切割工具，从而加快制作速度并提高成品品质。 - 在营地过滤器（Camp Filter）中加入了香蒲绒（Cattail Fluff）。 - 将“家畜饥饿耐久度”重命名为“饱食度”（Satiation）。 - 增加了干草料的重量，以更真实地反映其由大量原材料制成的特性。 - 在脏肠、脏肾和脏胃的名称中加入了“脏”（Dirty）字样，以强调这些部位在使用前需要先进行清洗。 - 呕吐不再直接降低士气，而是会显著降低满足感。 - 更新了“原木块”（Log Piece）的物品描述。 - 现在可以使用桤木树皮（Alder Bark）制作树皮凉鞋。 - 修复了熊、狼和“月触者”（Moontouched）被击杀后不掉落尸体的错误。 - 修复了在花园地块上使用容器内的液态灰烬（liquid ash）或生石灰（quick lime）时，会导致过多材料被损耗的错误。 - 野猪和其他动物现在会优先取食散落在周围的食物，然后再去破坏花园、农田或攻击家畜。 - 鹧鸪会优先食用小型或微型食物，而非大型食物。 - 修复了“月触者”在每次战斗后都会陷入镇静状态（Tranquilized）的错误——无论玩家是否使用了涂毒武器攻击他们。 - “生存装备”特质（Survival Gear Perk）现在提供的初始物品改为全新的金属制打火器（Fire Striker）和一块燧石，不再是旧款的打火器加燧石组合。 - 修复了胃部会被吸收进……的错误。……加入炖菜中（仅需15分钟）。 - 现在可以将肥料放入空麻袋、储物罐或类似的能容纳“液态”粉末的容器中，将其转化为“液态”形式。 - 使用梳麻板（hackle）梳理纤维现在会提升“织造”技能，而非“裁缝”技能。 - 修复了一个错误：在降低母鹿和公鹿的刷新率时，“橡树枯萎病”（Oak Blight）错误地检测了野猪种群数量，而非母鹿种群数量。 - 配重织机（Weighted Loom）、脚踏织机（Threadle Loom）和纺车现在都会为所在位置增加一定的“庇护值”（Sanctuary）。 - 重制了金属工具和武器蓝图的研究机制（研究工具后，会自动解锁相应的毛坯和铸模，无需额外研究）。 - 改进了各类粉末，使其特性更加统一。 - 麻袋不再能装水。 - 降低了解锁梳麻板、漏斗陷阱、树皮凉鞋和配重织机所需的“织造”技能等级，以适配近期“织造”技能获取机制的调整。 - 降低了制作漏斗陷阱和树皮凉鞋时获得的“织造”技能经验，使其与制作篮子或芦苇衣物时的收益保持一致。 - 制作绳索现在会提升“织造”技能。 - 修复了一个错误：烤炉在燃料耗尽后有时仍会产出木炭。 - 修复了“蚊虫平原北部”（Mosquito Flats North）旅行动作的一个错误：当路径结冰或被淹没时，该动作会将玩家传送到错误地点。 - “沼泽开局”特质（Swamp Start Perk）现在提供的材料是桤木（alder）而非橡木。 - “检查”花园地块（Garden Plot）的动作现在在无法执行时会显示提示信息。 - 修复了一个错误：当花园地块的“照料值”（Care）大于0时，无法将其摧毁。 - 修复了一个错误：熊穴出口无法生成。 - 修复了一个错误：拖放错误材料时，蓝图卡片会提示“X没有足够的Y”。 - 因包含空地点（empty locations）而损坏的存档，现在应能在游玩过程中自动修复。 - 修复了动物商人和金属商人的初始对话链接错误，使其不再跳转到通用商人的对话树。 - 从容器中饮水不再消耗时间。 - 烹饪锅蓝图现在会正确受到陶轮（Pottery Wheel）的影响。 - 修复了一个漏洞：当容器内仅有2个灰烬（ash）物品时，玩家却能从中取出10个。 - 熄灭状态的窑炉不再接受干树叶作为燃料。 - 修复了无法对野兔皮（Hare Leather）进行裁剪的错误。 - 新的“猎人（Huntsman）”开局现在会自带“狼群防护（Wolf Protection）”特质。 - 放置后的纤维处理台（Fiber Break）现在提供25点庇护值（sanctuary）。 - 修复了新环境有时会生成为空白导致玩家被卡住的错误。 - 降低了芦苇外套（Reed Coat）、纺锤（Spindle）、纤维处理台（Fiber Break）和纺车（Spinning Wheel）的解锁要求。 - 雄鹿尸体在腐烂或被动物吃掉时，现在会掉落鹿角。 - 修复了士气状态条与士气详细描述界面显示信息不一致的问题。 - 修正了手锯（Handsaw）工具蓝图中手锯形状的视觉表现。 - 刀鞘（Knife Sheath）现在可以重命名。 - 鱼类碎料（Fish scraps）现在能提供正确的营养值，并可用于炖菜。 - 沼泽香桃木叶（Bog Myrtle Leaves）现在可用于炖菜。 - 改进了箭头毛坯（Arrowhead blanks）和形状（shapes）的描述。 - “重制铁锭（Remake Iron Bar）”配方现在接受未完成或已完成的工具及武器头部作为材料。 - 移除了收集资源时细枝（twigs）的最大堆叠数量限制。 - “铁匠（Smith）”特质现在开局即完全解锁锻造炉（Forge）和块炼炉（Bloomery）。 - 降低了解锁陶轮（Pottery Wheel）所需的陶艺技能等级。 - 降低了重复制作已制作过的物品时，织造（Weaving）和陶艺（Pottery）技能获取的惩罚；且该惩罚会随时间推移而减轻。 - 制作麻绳（Twine）、纱线（Yarn）及各种尺寸的布料（小、中、大）现在提升织造技能，而非裁缝技能。 - 裁缝技能获取的惩罚现在会随时间推移而减轻。 - 将布袋（Cloth Sack）的材料消耗从2块大布料降低为1块。 - 使用纺车（Spinning Wheel）时，工作台（Workbench）不再加速纱线或麻绳的制作。 - 使用粘土制作陶器时，工作台不再提供加速效果。 - 纤维处理台、纺车和脚踏织布机（Treadle Loom）现在可以放置和回收，且仅在放置于场景中时生效。 - 铁制手锯的耐久度远低于斧头；在砍伐小树和灌木丛时，其效率也不如金属斧头。 - 修正了“干燥的石楠花茎”（Heather Stems Dried）的提示信息。 - 修正了“布袋”（Cloth Sack）的名称。 - 为“铁制打火器”（Iron Fire Striker）添加了“加热状态”下的美术素材。 - 修复了部分环境下场景无法正常加载，导致游戏因缺失环境卡牌而卡死的问题。 以上就是本次更新的全部内容！ 我们将对这些新系统进行持续微调，因此未来几周可能会频繁发布热修复补丁。;) 如果您希望我们添加特定的职责或特性（无论是生理还是心理层面的），请告诉我们，我们会尽力尽快将其加入游戏中！ 期待下次更新再见！ 温馨提示：所有修复内容和新功能都会先在公开测试分支（public beta branch）上线。 如果您想体验这些内容，可以查看下方链接中的说明。不过请注意，测试分支的稳定性相对较低，且游戏平衡性可能会频繁调整！:) https://steamcommunity.com/app/2868860/discussions/0/600774299444324511/
contents.en: Hello everyone! The time has finally come to release human NPCs into Card Survival: Fantasy Forest. First of all, be warned, This has been a big update for us, the biggest so far. For all of you brave souls in the beta branch, know that NPCs are big systems and there is only so much Neo and I can test in the limited time we had. There are no major bugs or issues that we could find, but there could always be some that escaped us, and balancing still needs a lot of work. :) We will be pushing lots of hotfixes over the following weeks, both with bug fixes, balance tweaks and some minor missing features. It is also worth pointing that NPCs are complex, and some of their systems will initially appear a bit obscure to most players. We'll be working on making these things clearer and easier to understand. And for now, we'll try to explain things as good as possible in this announcement. Also, no art. There was too much to do so I really didn't have to make art for the NPCs. Fortunately we made it so you can upload your own custom portraits, so I don't think it should be much of an issue. :) We'll be adding some official art as I get the time to work on it! Now, let's talk about the actual NPCS. Human NPCS: Human NPCs are called partners in the game, and they can be selected through perks or requested from the trader. You can create your own custom partner or select one of the existing ones (and edit them). We have included 6 partner presets: - The Craftsman: A nice and helpful husband. - The Dreamer: A less industrious but more romantic partner. - The Untamed: An independent self-reliant man. - The Hearthwife: A nice and helpful wife. - The Spirited: A more adventurous, companion to go on adventures with. - The Muse: A beautiful, but difficult partner, that won't really help much, at least not initially. I recommend you start with the Craftsman or the Hearthwife. :) The other partners are more difficult, still need to be balanced better, and are missing some features that will make them feel a lot more unique. Partners can eat, drink and sleep and help you in a lot of different ways. They can skin, flesh, tan, butcher, clean your house, keep your fire going, make your bed, forage, gather wood, chop down trees, gather mud, make mudbricks or clay, keep your gardens healthy, harvest your crops and more. They can also equip clothes on their own, based on comfort and temperature, and of course can also die of starvation or hypothermia, and leave you if you neglect them for long enough. The Duty System: Partners help through a contextual duty system. These duties, for now, belong to two different types. Marked Duties: Lots of items in the game can be marked for a duty. For example, you can mark a fire for the "firekeeping" duty. This will cause your partner to take care of that fire, so it never runs out of fuel. It is worth pointing out that some duties can only be performed if the right tools are available. For example, a carcass can be marked for skinning, but your partner will only skin it if they have a knife. Here's some of the marked duties available at the moment: - Firekeeping - Bedkeeping - House Cleaning - Mud Gathering - Harvesting Patches and Fields. - Gardening - Foraging - Wood Gathering - Skinning - Fleshing - Butchering - Cutting down trees. Inventory Duties: Items in your partner's inventory will be processed automatically if they are feeling grateful enough to you, provided they have the right tools to do it. They will for example, turn any nettle stalks in their inventory into fiber, and then process that fiber further into twine. Or grind any dry herbs, if they have a hammering tool in their inventories. Inventory duties can be toggled off through dialog, if you don't want them processing things. Here's a list of some of the inventory duties available at the moment: - Fiber Extraction - Cord Making - Pounding Sinew - Making Meat and Blood Filler - Making mud bricks. - Making Clay. - Gutting fish. - Butchering small animals. - Grinding herbs. - Pressing Cheese. Favour: Partners, like the player character, are not machines, and need to be treated well if one wants them to stay, be helpful or even survive. Favour is at the heart of this system. It accumulates over time based on how happy the NPC is with you and gets spent whenever they accomplish tasks for you. Partners will be more likely to perform duties if their favour is high, and will become less helpful the lower their favour gets. It is important not to ask too much of your partner initially or they will quickly grow resentful. Depending on your partner's personality, it's better to start slow, with just a few simple tasks, ideally ones they like, and gradually increase their responsibilities as their trust in you grows. It is also a good idea to disable their tasks if you see they're getting resentful, so their favour has a chance to recover. Preferences: Partners can have different personalities and likes. This will affect how fast they build up favour and how likely they are to perform some tasks over others as well as how costly they are for them. A partner might like methodical tasks, while another will prefer physical ones, etc.. There are different types of duties in the game at the moment: - Methodical: Weaving, grinding, etc... - Physical: Felling trees, chopping wood, butchering, etc.. - Nurturing: Firekeeping, Tending Gardens, Cleaning, etc... - Creative: Playing music, carving wood, etc... - Nature: Gathering Wood, Foraging, etc... Many duties don't belong to one specific category but to multiple. Relationship System: Partners are complex systems, just like the player. They have gratification, wellbeing, morale, hunger, appetite, satiation, etc... Some of their systems are still not in (like the immune system), but there's already enough for them to work properly. The idea with partners, is that you help them, and they help you back in return. But for this to work, they need to trust you. Trust builds over time, based on your partner's personality traits, on how grateful they feel, how much they like you and how well you treat them. Once trust is high enough, affection will start increasing, and things will become easier. With your partner progressively having more favour to spend, and therefore becoming more helpful. There are other factors that play a big role too. For example. if your partner is attracted to you, and if it eventually becomes infatuated, that can really help them generate favour and trust faster as they will be more actively interested in you. Relationships usually go: - Partner builds trust until they're comfortable with you. - Partner starts growing affection towards you. -Partner can become infatuated if they are attracted to you, in which case things get easier. Dialog System: Communicating with your partner and giving them attention is essential to keeping them happy. Both you and your partner have a stat called "connection" which goes down over time and can only be increased by communicating with others. Partners will want attention if their connection starts getting low, and will start feeling neglected if you don't speak with them for too long. To leave room for imagination and make the writing manageable, we've made the system work on an abstract level. So basically you choose what you want to express on an abstract level (gratitude, affection, attraction, needs, etc...) and your partner reacts positively or negatively based on the interactions between both of your stats. There are two main dialog windows for partners: Expression and Direction. Directions: Direction is a simple menu, mostly practical, where you can ask partners to do the following things: Follow/Stop Following: This one causes your partner to follow you constantly or to stop following you. Following costs a little bit of favour, so keep that in mind, especially for partners that have a tendency to go resentful easily. Mark as Home: This is essential. You should always mark your house or camp as your "home". This will cause your partner to return there when they stop following you, or when they are done doing some duties away from you. Process/Stop Processing Inventory: This one toggles your partner's inventory duties. This is important if they are helping you transport goods you don't want them to process. Expression: This is the main dialog menu, where most communication happens. Here you communicate with your partner and produce different results based on yours and your partner's stats. Effective communication is not guaranteed, and players can easily make things awkward or anger their partners by spamming interactions or expressing the wrong things. Social skills, attraction levels, assertiveness, empathy, trust, affection and other factors play a big role in determining how each interaction goes. There is also a stat called awkwardness which is especially important. It accumulates with repeated or failed interactions and can quickly mess up most attempts at communication if it gets too high. So if you noticed you failed an interaction, take a break and wait until your partner doesn't feel awkward anymore (by checking their details tab) before attempting further communication. There are many ways to communicate in the Expression menu: Casual Talk: This one is a generally safe option. Low risk for awkwardness but rewards are usually minor. Can be used mostly for relationship maintenance, especially at the beginning. When you need to give attention to your partner but you don't want to risk a bad interaction. Listen: Can be found in the "Express Care" submenu. This is another low risk interaction, but one that has a greater effect on your partner. It is one of the best actions to generally use, especially with more difficult partners, but requires high focus levels to work. Express Gratitude: Also found in the "Express Care" submenu. Ideally used when favour is getting low. It's the most likely to work when partners are getting just a bit resentful, not too resentful or grateful. Express Affection: Also an "Express Care" option. A good interaction that mostly only works once there's real affection between you and your partner. Express Attraction and Intimacy: These two interactions only really works if there's attraction between you and your partner, and will play bigger roles in the future, once you can start families. Express Need for Help: This interaction consists of you asking your partner to help more and will generate a substantial amount of favour if successful. It has the power to offend them if it fails though. Express Need for Emotional Support: In this interaction is successful, your partner will help your restore some morale. These are the options available at the moment, but we'll be tweaking and adding additional ones over the following months. Partner Expression Partners can also express themselves on their own. And will let you know if they're too hungry, feel to neglected, are feeling attracted or grateful, etc... We will be adding more options here in the future, so partners can get greater autonomy, and feel more alive. Partner Creation: Partners are built with perks, just like player characters. You can either build them from scratch through the custom partner perk, or edit existing presets through their respective perks. Personality: A partner's personality can really change your experience with them. Through these perks you should be able to determine what kind of duties they will prefer, how helpful they are, and how quickly you can progress through their relationship. Attraction: Attraction is important, so you should make sure your partner and your character are compatible, unless of course you want some extra challenge. Partners in Fantasy Forest are not player-sexual, so you need to make sure that they will be attracted to your character if that's what you want. Appearance: The game tracks lots of partner visual features, from hair length, colour and type, to hip or should width, jaw size, or eye separation. These traits not only help make partners more real and substantial but also have a real effect on their attractiveness, masculinity and femininity values. It is worth pointing out that some of these visual traits can equipped directly with perks, while others only emerge indirectly, through the effects of hormones, height and weight. Knowledge Knowledge perks grant skills to the partners. These are not active at the moment, as partners don't currently have skills connected to the duty system, but they can already be equipped in preparation for the future. The Future for NPCS: This update is only the first step for NPCs. We have a lot of things planned that we'll be releasing over the following months. Some of the biggest things you can expect are: More Marked and Inventory Duties: Lots more duties with which to enrich the partners, including smithing, playing music and carving. Expedition Duties: These are complex duties that will have the Partner go on a trip for some time, and then return once they're done. Examples of these are extensive foraging trips, trap checking, fishing and hunting. Marking Blueprint : The ability to make blueprints so that your partner can complete it for you. Especially useful for expensive multi-step duties like road or house building. Cooking Duties: A new complex type of duty that will have partners processing food items and cooking for themselves and for you. Combat: Partners participating in combat, making taking on more dangerous enemies a bit more manageable. Family Making: The ability for partners to get pregnant (or get you pregnant), babies, toddlers, children and teenagers. New Advanced NPCs: Hunting dogs, pack animals, familiars, human travellers and hunters, improved traders. New Partner Deaths: The ability for partners to get sick or get hurt and die from wounds. Dialog Improvements: Improvements to the dialog system, including quality of life changes and many new options. Version EA_0.66 and Patch Notes since the last announcement: - Added partner creator with all its perks. - Added complex duty systems. - Added partner physical, mental, attraction and social systems. - Added 6 partner presets. - Added the ability to request partners from the general trader. - Added npc equipment system. - Blood now coagulates directly into solid blood curds. - Fixed a bug where flours and grains did not get preserved inside cellars and containers. - Fixed a bug where the Second Boar was fleeing to the wrong area. - Wheelbarrow can now transport powdery materials such as clay. - Releasing the Spirit of a Mouse or a Frog now takes 3 minutes. - Fixed the bug with Boars stuck in the same area not attacking the player or doing anything else. - Fixed the Wood Sorrel has dried notification. - Fixed a bug where rain was reducing mosquitos twice. - Quern no longer shows progress durability. - Fixed a bug preventing the move from Boggy Meadows to Black Mire during the night. - Fixed a bug with inconsistencies when adding and removing powders to clay jars. - Pottery Wheel now speeds up the creation of Crucibles. - Cellar improvement no longer unlocks if you have a tree log on board. contents.ja: 免責事項：この告知は機械翻訳を使用しています。用語に誤りがある場合はご容赦ください。 皆さん、こんにちは！ ついに『Card Survival: Fantasy Forest』に人間のNPCを実装する時が来ました。 まず最初にお伝えしておきたいのですが、これは私たちにとって過去最大規模のアップデートとなります。 ベータ版をプレイしてくださっている勇敢な皆さんにお伝えしておきますと、NPCは大規模なシステムであり、限られた時間の中でNeoと私が行えるテストには限界がありました。現時点で重大なバグや問題は見つかっていませんが、見落としがあるかもしれませんし、バランス調整もまだ多くの作業を必要としています。 :) 今後数週間にわたり、バグ修正、バランス調整、そして未実装だった細かな機能の追加など、多くのホットフィックス（修正パッチ）を配信していく予定です。 また、NPCのシステムは複雑であり、最初は多くのプレイヤーにとって少し分かりにくい部分があるかもしれません。今後、それらをより明確で理解しやすいものにするよう取り組んでいきます。 とりあえず、今回の告知で可能な限り詳しく説明したいと思います。 それから、アート（画像）についてですが、今回は用意していません。やるべきことがあまりにも多く、NPC用のアートを制作する時間が取れませんでした。幸い、独自のカスタムポートレートをアップロードできる仕様にしていますので、大きな問題にはならないと思います。 :) 時間ができ次第、公式のアートも追加していく予定です！ それでは、実際のNPCについてお話ししましょう。 人間のNPC： 人間のNPCはゲーム内では「パートナー」と呼ばれ、パーク（特典）で選択したり、商人から依頼したりすることで仲間にできます。 独自のカスタムパートナーを作成することも、既存のパートナーを選択（および編集）することも可能です。 以下の6種類のパートナー・プリセットを用意しました： - 職人（The Craftsman）：親切で頼りになる夫。 - 夢想家（The Dreamer）：勤勉さは控えめだが、ロマンチックなパートナー。 - 野生児（The Untamed）：自立心が強く、独立した男性。 - 家庭的な妻（The Hearthwife）：親切で頼りになる妻。 - 快活な冒険者（The Spirited）：冒険を共にする、活動的で冒険心あふれるパートナー。 - ミューズ（The Muse）：美しくも気難しいパートナーです。あまり役には立ちません――少なくとも最初は。 まずは「職人（Craftsman）」か「家を守る妻（Hearthwife）」から始めることをお勧めします。:) 他のパートナーは難易度が高く、バランス調整の余地があり、個性を際立たせる機能もまだ不足しています。 パートナーは食事、飲水、睡眠を行い、様々な形であなたを助けてくれます。彼らは皮剥ぎ、肉の処理（皮裏の肉削ぎ）、なめし、解体、家事（掃除）、火の維持、ベッドメイキング、野草や食料の採取、薪集め、伐採、泥集め、泥レンガや粘土の作成、庭の手入れ、作物の収穫などを行えます。 また、快適さや気温に応じて自分で服を身につけることもできますし、当然ながら飢えや低体温症で死ぬこともあります。長い間放置すれば、あなたのもとを去ってしまうでしょう。 任務システム（Duty System）： パートナーは、状況に応じた「任務（Duty）」システムを通じて手助けをしてくれます。 現時点では、これらの任務は大きく分けて2つのタイプがあります。 指定任務（Marked Duties）： ゲーム内の多くのアイテムに対し、任務を指定（マーク）することができます。例えば、焚き火に「火の維持（firekeeping）」という任務を指定すると、パートナーがその火の世話をして、燃料切れにならないようにしてくれます。 重要な点として、適切な道具がなければ実行できない任務もあります。例えば、動物の死骸に「皮剥ぎ」の任務を指定しても、パートナーがナイフを持っていなければ実行されません。 現時点で利用可能な指定任務には、以下のようなものがあります： - 火の維持 - ベッドの整備 - 家の掃除 - 泥集め - 野草地や畑の収穫 - 庭の手入れ - 野草・食料の採取 - 薪集め - 皮剥ぎ - 肉の処理（皮裏の肉削ぎ） - 解体 - 伐採 インベントリ任務（Inventory Duties）： パートナーのインベントリにあるアイテムは、適切な道具さえあれば、彼らがあなたに十分な感謝の念を抱いている場合に自動的に加工されます。 例えば、インベントリにあるイラクサの茎を繊維に加工し、さらにその繊維を紐（トワイン）に加工するといった具合です。あるいは、所持品に「叩き潰すための道具（ハンマーなど）」があれば、乾燥ハーブをすり潰すことも可能です。 作業を行わせたくない場合は、会話を通じて作業の割り当てをオフにすることができます。 現時点で利用可能な作業のリストは以下の通りです： - 繊維の抽出 - 紐作り - 腱（けん）を叩いてほぐす - 肉と血液の詰め物作り - 泥レンガ作り - 粘土作り - 魚の腹わた取り - 小動物の解体 - ハーブのすり潰し - チーズの圧搾 好感度： プレイヤーキャラクターと同様、パートナーも機械ではありません。彼らにとどまってもらい、役に立ってもらい、さらには生き延びてもらうためには、大切に扱う必要があります。 このシステムの中心となるのが「好感度」です。好感度は、NPCがプレイヤーに対してどれだけ満足しているかに応じて時間の経過とともに蓄積され、プレイヤーのために作業を行うたびに消費されます。 好感度が高いほどパートナーは作業を積極的に引き受けてくれますが、好感度が下がると協力的な姿勢は薄れていきます。 最初はパートナーに多くを求めすぎないことが重要です。さもないと、すぐに不満を抱かせてしまうでしょう。 パートナーの性格にもよりますが、まずは簡単な作業――できれば彼らが好むような作業――から始め、信頼関係が深まるにつれて徐々に任せる仕事を増やしていくのが得策です。 また、相手が不満を抱き始めているようなら、タスク（仕事）を一時的に停止させるのが良いでしょう。そうすることで、相手の「好感度（favour）」が回復する余地が生まれます。 好み（Preferences）: パートナーにはそれぞれ異なる性格や好みがあります。これらは、好感度が溜まる速さ、特定のタスクを優先する傾向、そしてそのタスクを行う際の負担感などに影響します。例えば、几帳面な作業を好むパートナーもいれば、肉体労働を好むパートナーもいる、といった具合です。 現時点で、ゲーム内には以下のような種類の任務（Duties）が存在します： - 几帳面な作業（Methodical）：機織り、粉砕（製粉）など - 肉体労働（Physical）：伐採、薪割り、解体など - 世話・管理（Nurturing）：火の番、庭の手入れ、掃除など - 創作（Creative）：楽器演奏、木彫りなど - 自然関連（Nature）：木材の収集、採集など 多くの任務は単一のカテゴリーではなく、複数のカテゴリーにまたがっています。 関係性システム: パートナーはプレイヤーと同様に、複雑なシステムで構成されています。彼らには「満足度」「健康状態」「士気」「空腹度」「食欲」「満腹度」などのステータスがあります。 免疫系など、まだ実装されていないシステムもありますが、現時点でも彼らが適切に機能するための要素は十分に揃っています。 パートナーとの関係の基本は、あなたが彼らを助け、彼らもそれに応えてあなたを助けてくれるというものです。しかし、これがうまくいくには、彼らがあなたを信頼している必要があります。 信頼は時間の経過とともに築かれます。その度合いは、パートナーの性格、感謝の念、あなたへの好意、そしてあなたが彼らにどう接するかによって決まります。 信頼が高まると「愛情（affection）」が育ち始め、状況がよりスムーズになります。パートナーが使える好感度（favour）の蓄積量が増えるため、より積極的に協力してくれるようになるからです。 他にも重要な要因があります。例えば、パートナーがあなたに惹かれ、やがて「夢中（infatuated）」な状態になると、あなたへの関心が強まるため、好感度や信頼をより早く築けるようになります。 関係性の一般的な流れは以下の通りです： - パートナーとの信頼関係が築かれ、あなたに対して安心感を抱くようになる。 - パートナーがあなたに対して愛情を抱き始める。 - あなたに惹かれている場合、パートナーがあなたに「夢中」になることがあり、そうなると状況がより有利に進むようになる。 会話システム: パートナーとコミュニケーションを取り、気にかけてあげることは、彼らの機嫌を良く保つために不可欠です。 プレイヤーとパートナーの双方には「コネクション（絆）」というステータスがあり、これは時間の経過とともに低下しますが、相手とコミュニケーションを取ることでのみ上昇させることができます。 コネクションが低下するとパートナーは関心を求めるようになり、長い間話しかけずにいると、放置されていると感じて不満を抱くようになります。 想像の余地を残しつつ、テキスト量を管理しやすくするため、このシステムは抽象的なレベルで機能するように設計されています。つまり、プレイヤーは「感謝」「愛情」「好意」「要望」といった抽象的な意図を選んで伝え、パートナーは双方のステータスに基づいた相互作用の結果として、好意的または否定的な反応を返します。 パートナーとの会話には、「意思表示（Expression）」と「指示（Direction）」という2つの主要なメニューがあります。 指示 (Directions): 「指示」は主に実用的な操作を行うためのシンプルなメニューで、パートナーに以下の行動を命じることができます。 追従 / 追従停止: パートナーに常にプレイヤーの後をついてこさせたり、追従を止めさせたりします。追従には「好感度（Favour）」をわずかに消費するため、特に不満を抱きやすい性格のパートナーを連れている場合は注意が必要です。 拠点を指定 (Mark as Home): これは非常に重要な機能です。自宅やキャンプを「拠点（Home）」として指定しておくべきです。そうすることで、追従を解除した際や、プレイヤーから離れて任務を終えた際に、パートナーはそこへ戻るようになります。 インベントリ処理の開始 / 停止: パートナーのインベントリ処理（アイテム加工など）のタスクを切り替えます。加工してほしくない物資の運搬を手伝ってもらっている場合などに重要となる設定です。 意思表示 (Expression): これは主要な会話メニューであり、コミュニケーションの大部分はここで行われます。 ここではパートナーと意思疎通を図りますが、その結果はプレイヤーとパートナー双方のステータスによって変化します。必ずしも円滑なコミュニケーションができるとは限らず、同じ行動を連発したり、不適切な内容を伝えたりすると、気まずい雰囲気になったり、パートナーを怒らせたりすることもあります。 ろくろをアンロックするために必要な陶芸スキルの量を減らしました。 - 既に作成したアイテムを再度作成する際の織物と陶芸のスキル獲得ペナルティを軽減し、一定時間経過後にペナルティが軽減されるようになりました。 - 麻ひも、糸、小布、中布、大布の作成で、裁縫スキルではなく織物スキルが獲得できるようになりました。 - 裁縫スキル獲得ペナルティが一定時間経過後に軽減されるようになりました。 -
